user.title: xquirks
user.description:
Offers the quirk files that match your ZHA devices. Nothing is written until you confirm the change list in Repairs.

ZHA's custom quirks folder: `{folder}`

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only one entry is possible.

init.title: What xquirks offers
init.description:
**Devices**: xquirks installs no file just for these devices. Files only they use go with the next change list. A file another device needs is installed or kept anyway: ZHA applies it to these devices too (the change list names them).

Devices disabled in Home Assistant are left alone the same way.

**Offer high-risk files**: xquirks holds back files for covers and thermostats, files that replace ZHA's own quirk and files with a known weak spot until they are verified on a device. Turn this on to get them in the change list anyway, marked with their risk.

missing_quirks_path.title: ZHA has no custom quirks folder
missing_quirks_path.description:
ZHA loads custom quirk files only from a folder named in configuration.yaml. Until there is one, xquirks offers nothing.

1. Create the folder, for example `/config/custom_zha_quirks` (with the File editor, Samba or SSH app). It has to exist before the next step.
2. Add these lines to `configuration.yaml`:

```yaml
zha:
  custom_quirks_path: /config/custom_zha_quirks/
```

3. Restart Home Assistant.

folder_unreadable.title: The custom quirks folder cannot be read
folder_unreadable.description:
xquirks cannot read ZHA's custom quirks folder `{folder}`: {error}

Until it can, xquirks writes nothing and leaves the change list and notices as they are. Check the folder's permissions.

no_content_state.title: xquirks has no quirk list yet
no_content_state.description:
xquirks has no list of quirk files it can use yet: {reason}

It tries again every 15 minutes. **Check for quirk updates** (Settings > Devices & services > xquirks) tries now.

changes.title: Quirk changes for your Zigbee devices: {count}

confirm.title: Quirk changes

abort.not_loaded: xquirks is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
abort.stale: Nothing was changed: the list changed while this dialog was open. The new one is under Settings > System > Repairs.
abort.held_pending: Nothing was changed: an earlier change waits for ZHA to load the custom quirks folder again. Reload ZHA or wait for its next start.
abort.held_unchecked: Nothing was changed: a file of the list could not be downloaded and checked yet. xquirks tries again in a few minutes.
abort.held_zha_unknown: Nothing was changed: ZHA is not loaded or xquirks cannot read which quirks it applies. The list waits for ZHA.
abort.held_no_content: Nothing was changed: xquirks has no quirk list it can use right now.
abort.held_no_folder: Nothing was changed: ZHA has no custom quirks folder.
abort.held_unreadable_folder: Nothing was changed: the custom quirks folder cannot be read.
abort.failed:
Nothing was changed: {failed}

xquirks put back what it had changed before this step. Once the cause is gone, the repair lists what is left to do.
abort.done:
{done}

ZHA is reloading `{folder}` now: your Zigbee devices are back in a few seconds.
abort.done_zha_not_loaded:
{done}

ZHA is not loaded right now. It uses the changes in `{folder}` when it starts.
abort.not_now: Put aside: nothing was changed. To decide later: Settings > System > Repairs > three-dot menu > Show ignored repairs. A different list comes back as a new repair.

blocked.title: {quirk} runs on another custom quirk
blocked.description:
{picture}{devices}

xquirks has `{file}` for it ({status}) but does not write it while a custom quirk of yours handles the device: ZHA would pick one of the two. To switch, remove your quirk file and reload ZHA. The change list then brings `{file}`.

held_back.title: High-risk quirk held back: {quirk}

users_file.title: Your file has the name of a quirk: {quirk}
users_file.description:
{picture}`{file}` in `{folder}` has the name of an xquirks file, but xquirks did not write it. It leaves your file alone and cannot install its own.

To use the xquirks file, delete yours and reload ZHA. The change list then brings it.

not_applied.title: ZHA does not use the quirk: {quirk}

misfit.title: Quirk does not fit your device: {quirk}

changed.title: Changed quirk left alone: {quirk}
changed.description:
{picture}`{file}` in `{folder}` was changed after xquirks installed it. xquirks leaves it as it is: no change list updates or removes it.

To hand it back to xquirks, undo your change or delete the file.

reload.title: Quirk changes wait for a ZHA reload: {count}

confirm.title: Reload ZHA

abort.not_loaded: xquirks is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
abort.nothing_to_do: Nothing to do any more: the files or devices changed in the meantime.
abort.not_now: Put aside: ZHA uses the changes when it next loads, at the latest after a restart of Home Assistant. To decide later: Settings > System > Repairs > three-dot menu > Show ignored repairs.

withdrawn_copy.title: Withdrawn quirk copy: {quirk}
withdrawn_copy.description:
{picture}`{file}` in `{folder}` has no record in xquirks: it was put there by hand or its record was lost. It is revision {revision}, which was withdrawn: {reason}

ZHA loads it for your devices. Remove it from the folder and reload ZHA. The change list then brings the current file if there is one for this Home Assistant release.

withdrawn_installed.title: Withdrawn quirk revision in use: {quirk}
withdrawn_installed.description:
{picture}`{file}` in `{folder}` is revision {revision}, which was withdrawn: {reason}

ZHA uses it for your devices until the change list updates or removes it. The list is in Settings > System > Repairs, an ignored one under Show ignored repairs.

download_waiting.title: Quirk changes wait for a download

unavailable.title: Quirk file cannot be downloaded: {quirk}
unavailable.description:
`{file}` cannot be used: {error}

No change list writes it. An installed copy stays at its revision while its devices use it and no other file takes one of them. Please report it in the xquirks issue tracker with the xquirks diagnostics (Settings > Devices & services > xquirks > three-dot menu > Download diagnostics).

refused.title: Quirk file refused: {quirk}
refused.description:
`{file}` (revision {revision}) holds code xquirks does not allow in a quirk file or targets devices it is not offered for. xquirks refused it: no change list writes it. An installed copy stays at its revision while its devices use it and no other file takes one of them. The change list says when it goes.

This should never happen. It can mean that someone tampered with the repository xquirks loads its quirk files from. Please report it in the xquirks issue tracker with the xquirks diagnostics (Settings > Devices & services > xquirks > three-dot menu > Download diagnostics).
